title: Crash on long URLs exceeding 2048 characters

print(f"[REPRO] Calling parse_url with payload length {len(long_payload)}...")
result = parse_url(long_payload)
print("[REPRO] Unexpected success:", result)

    print(f"[PoC-TEST] normalize_scheme returned:", res)
except Exception as ex:
    print(f"[PoC-TEST] Safe exception handled: {ex}")
